title: A visit with a local touch
text: Vangelis was a great guide, showing not only the sights of the City but also showing the daily aspect of the City and areas that are not very busy but of great interest.
author: 293ger

title: Excellent, caring guide with deep knowledge of architecture and history
text: We took two tours with Vangelis, and both were phenomenal. His in-depth knowledge of architecture absolutely shone, and he provided insights and details that brought history alive. Equally important, he was personable and caring. He truly cared about our interests. As a foodie, I appreciated the restaurants he chose for lunch: all offered delicious dishes we would not have found on our own. I would recommend his tours to anyone.
author: APracticalIdealist

title: Tour in Greek to the most important monuments with local architect
text: Enjoyed the tour of the Alcathar Palace, the Cathedral and the Santa Cruz district with Vangelis!
author: georgesQ5366ZJ
